I-spline basis

Source: R/ispline.R
ispline_basis.Rd

Monotone splines of Ramsay (1988): each \(I_m\) rises from 0 to 1 and is the integral of an M-spline of order `order`. Computed as right cumulative sums of B-splines of order `order + 1` on the clamped knot vector over \([-4, 4]\); \(\eta\) is clamped to that range as for [bspline_basis()].

Usage

ispline_basis(eta, interior = numeric(0), order = 2)

Arguments

eta

latent values

interior

interior knots (see [ispline_knots()])

order

I-spline order k (2 = piecewise quadratic, Ramsay's default)

Value

length(eta) x (length(interior) + order) matrix

References

Ramsay JO (1988). Monotone regression splines in action. Statistical Science 3, 425-461.
